item.title: Aitino Open-Source Platform Uses Node Editor to Create AI Agent Teams
item.description:
Aitino Open-Source Platform Uses Node Editor to Create AI Agent Teams

Aitino is an open-source platform designed for creating teams of AI Agents to automate high-level tasks and solve complex problems without lengthy and complicated setups.

🔍 Overview

The platform aims to go from a prompt to a solution in a matter of minutes. Users need to provide only required information, such as API keys, context, and specific task details, taking just seconds to configure.

🧩 How it works

  • Node Editor: Aitino features a visual node editor interface, designed to remain simple for small use cases while scaling for highly complex agent teams.
  • Autogen Framework: The platform is built on top of the Autogen Framework.
  • System Integration: Aitino plans to merge principles from other multi-agent projects, such as ChatDev and CrewAI, to support features that are out of reach using Autogen alone.

⚙️ Key details

Source code for the platform is publicly available, and the project actively welcomes contributions and suggestions. Developers interested in paid development opportunities can reach out to join the project. The technology stack powering Aitino includes:

  • Framework: SvelteKit
  • Styling: TailwindCSS
  • Components: shacn-svelte
  • Database: Supabase
  • Payment Processing: Stripe
  • Hosting: Vercel

📅 Release roadmap

Date Release Details
Feb 16 Waitlist Launch Initial waitlist opening
Mar 3 v0.1.0 Release Simple functionality for creating and running a team of AI Agents
Mar 26 v0.2.0 Release Enhanced functionalities including auto-build, applet builder, community features, and multi-modal task solving
Apr 17 v1.0.0 Release First official release with final touches

🚀 Availability

Aitino Web serves as the cloud-hosted version of the platform. A free plan is coming soon to allow users to test the platform’s capabilities.

#Aitino #AIAgents #OpenSource #Autogen #DeveloperTools

Source: startino/aitino

item.title: ServiceNow Launches AI Workflow Factory for Continuous Agentic Workflow Improvement
item.description:
ServiceNow Launches AI Workflow Factory for Continuous Agentic Workflow Improvement

ServiceNow announced the AI Workflow Factory, a platform that turns workflow improvement into a continuous, agentic AI‑powered loop. The announcement also introduced Flow by ServiceNow, an AI service desk that can be deployed instantly, and highlighted new agent‑to‑agent capabilities emerging from collaborations with Work4Flow and LogicMonitor.

🔍 Overview

  • AI Workflow Factory launches to enable a continuous loop of workflow improvement powered by AI agents.
  • Flow by ServiceNow is a new AI service desk that deploys instantly.
  • Work4Flow and LogicMonitor extend Edwin AI investigations in ServiceNow with new agent‑to‑agent capabilities.

🧩 How it works

  • Workflows are continuously analyzed and refined by AI agents, creating an ongoing improvement cycle.
  • The system leverages agentic AI, meaning AI entities act autonomously to identify and apply enhancements.
  • Agent‑to‑agent capabilities allow separate AI components (e.g., Edwin AI, Work4Flow, LogicMonitor) to cooperate on investigations and optimizations.

⚙️ Key details

  • Continuous, self‑optimizing workflow loop.
  • Agentic AI that can act without direct human commands.
  • Instant deployment of the Flow AI service desk.
  • Integration of multiple AI agents for deeper investigations (Edwin AI, Work4Flow, LogicMonitor).

🚀 Availability

  • Flow by ServiceNow can be deployed immediately after announcement.
  • AI Workflow Factory is positioned as a new service offering from ServiceNow.

💡 Why it matters

  • Enables enterprises to keep their processes up‑to‑date automatically.
  • Reduces the manual effort required to monitor and improve workflows.
  • Combines multiple AI agents to broaden investigative reach and accelerate problem resolution.

#ServiceNow #AIWorkflow #AgenticAI #Automation

Source: ServiceNow, Inc. (NOW) latest press releases and corporate news – Yahoo Finance

item.title: Certinia Expands Veda Suite With 14 Autonomous Agents and 135 Tools
item.description:
Certinia Expands Veda Suite With 14 Autonomous Agents and 135 Tools

Certinia has expanded its Veda suite by adding 14 autonomous agents and expanding its Intelligent Actions library to 135 tools.

🧩 How it works

The platform connects and coordinates key processes across the enterprise lifecycle by performing the following actions:

  • Workflow Coordination: It coordinates professional services, customer success, and accounting processes.
  • General Ledger Actions: It executes general ledger actions through Model Context Protocol connections.

⚙️ Key details

The expansion introduces several key updates to the platform’s automation capabilities:

  • Autonomous Agents: The suite now includes 14 new autonomous agents.
  • Intelligent Actions: The system’s tool library has been expanded to a total of 135 tools.
  • Operational Reach: The tools span professional services, customer success, and accounting workflows.

#Certinia #AIagents #EnterpriseSoftware
